description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A biomedical engineer needs a 'negative' mold of the skull for packaging design — a solid block representing the full scan volume with the skull anatomy subtracted as a void. Create a bone segmentation mask (using the Bone preset, 226–3071 HU), INVERT the mask so that it represents the space *around* the bone, generate a 3D surface from this inverted mask, and export it as a binary STL file to /home/ga/Documents/negative_mold.stl. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
